title: Where the world's music comes from
excerpt: I mapped the birthplaces of 283,424 musicians and the home towns of 29,489 bands in Wikidata: New York, London, Paris and Vienna lead, every genre has a home town from Kingston to Seoul, Finland has the most metal bands per head, and women went from 8% of musicians born before 1800 to 42% of those born in the 1990s.
seo_description: A map of where musicians were born and bands formed: top cities, the home town of each genre, Nordic metal, and women's share over time.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the world's music comes from' in black, red and gold on cream, beside a world map of hexagons shaded from pale yellow to deep plum by the number of musicians born there, darkest in central Europe, the eastern United States and Japan.
